###############################################################################
# NSX Module: hkv_denoise_aot
#
#   Generated by heliaAOT v0.23.0 on 2026-09-26
#
#   This CMakeLists.txt is designed for the neuralspotx (NSX) build system.
#   It requires:
#     - NSX_BOARD_FLAGS_TARGET  (board-specific compile flags)
#     - nsx::cmsis_nn           (CMSIS-NN kernel library)
#
#   For standalone CMake builds without NSX, use --module.type=cmake instead.
#
###############################################################################

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
include(GNUInstallDirs)

# ── Guard: NSX board flags must be defined ────────────────────────────────
if(NOT DEFINED NSX_BOARD_FLAGS_TARGET)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "hkv_denoise_aot: NSX_BOARD_FLAGS_TARGET is not defined.\n"
        "This module requires the NSX build system. Use --module.type=cmake for standalone builds.")
endif()

# ── Static library (shared boilerplate from macros.j2) ────────────────────
add_library(hkv_denoise_aot STATIC)

target_compile_features(hkv_denoise_aot PUBLIC c_std_99)

target_sources(hkv_denoise_aot PRIVATE
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_reshape_0.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_depthwise_conv_2d_1.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_depthwise_conv_2d_2.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_conv_2d_3.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_depthwise_conv_2d_4.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_mean_5.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_conv_2d_6.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_conv_2d_7.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_minimum_8.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_relu_9.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_mul_10.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_conv_2d_11.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_depthwise_conv_2d_12.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_mean_13.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_conv_2d_14.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_conv_2d_15.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_minimum_16.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_relu_17.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_mul_18.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_conv_2d_19.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_depthwise_conv_2d_20.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_mean_21.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_conv_2d_22.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_conv_2d_23.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_minimum_24.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_relu_25.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_mul_26.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_conv_2d_27.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_conv_2d_28.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_reshape_29.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_model.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_tensors.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_constants.c
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/src/hkv_denoise_context.c
)

target_include_directories(hkv_denoise_aot PUBLIC
  $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/includes-api>
  $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/nsx/modules/hkv_denoise_aot/includes-api>
)

# ── NSX alias / export name ───────────────────────────────────────────────
set_target_properties(hkv_denoise_aot PROPERTIES EXPORT_NAME hkv_denoise_aot)
add_library(nsx::hkv_denoise_aot ALIAS hkv_denoise_aot)

# ── Dependencies ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if(NOT TARGET nsx::cmsis_nn)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "hkv_denoise_aot: nsx::cmsis_nn is missing. Add the NSX CMSIS-NN module before this module.")
endif()
target_link_libraries(hkv_denoise_aot
    PUBLIC
        ${NSX_BOARD_FLAGS_TARGET}
        nsx::cmsis_nn
)

# Query the linked library's capabilities; never override its float switches.
# Enable only the types this module uses before adding ns-cmsis-nn:
#   set(ARM_NN_ENABLE_F32 ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
if(NOT COMMAND ns_cmsis_nn_float_support)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "hkv_denoise_aot: linked nsx::cmsis_nn does not provide ns_cmsis_nn_float_support(). "
        "Load the NSX entry point from ns-cmsis-nn >= 7.35.0 before this module.")
endif()
ns_cmsis_nn_float_support(F32 _helia_nn_f32 F16 _helia_nn_f16 TARGET nsx::cmsis_nn)

if(NOT _helia_nn_f32)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "hkv_denoise_aot: requires ns-cmsis-nn built with ARM_NN_ENABLE_F32=ON. "
        "Set ARM_NN_ENABLE_F32=ON before adding the kernel library; "
        "for a prebuilt library, select a package built with this precision enabled.")
endif()

# ── Memory placement override hook ────────────────────────────────────────
# Consumers (e.g. heliaPROFILER) can set this to a header that redefines
# the HKV_DENOISE_PUT_IN_* macros with real section attributes.
# The header is force-preincluded so it takes effect before platform.h's
# #ifndef guards.
if(DEFINED HKV_DENOISE_AOT_ATTRIBUTES_HEADER)
    if(EXISTS "${HKV_DENOISE_AOT_ATTRIBUTES_HEADER}")
        target_compile_options(hkv_denoise_aot PUBLIC
            "-include${HKV_DENOISE_AOT_ATTRIBUTES_HEADER}"
        )
    else()
        message(WARNING
            "hkv_denoise_aot: attributes header not found: "
            "${HKV_DENOISE_AOT_ATTRIBUTES_HEADER}")
    endif()
endif()

# ── Install ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
install(DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/includes-api
    DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}/nsx/modules/hkv_denoise_aot)
install(TARGETS hkv_denoise_aot EXPORT nsxTargets)
